title: auritus killswitch calls a non-existent /admin/killswitch route
description:
`cli/src/auritus/api.py` `disable_batch_queue` / `enable_batch_queue` POST to `/admin/killswitch`, which is not a route on `auritus-api` (404). The CLI then falls back to boto3 `UpdateJobQueue`, which only works if the operator has AWS credentials and `batch_queue` in config.

Fix: call `POST /admin/queue/toggle` with `{"state": "DISABLED"}` / `{"state": "ENABLED"}`. Keep the boto3 fallback. Gherkin scenario in `features/spend_guardrails.feature`.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged in #71. `auritus killswitch disable|enable` now POSTs `{"state": ...}` to `/admin/queue/toggle`; the kill switch and queue toggle scenarios run the real CLI against the router. CLI change ships with the next release; no backend deploy needed. Follow-up: auritus-d9d878.
